p2.detail: Parent API token is checked at HTTP admission and for new requests. An already-admitted web write can finish after parent API revocation/expiry because commit-time verification rechecks the child browser token/web_sessions row and normal repository write checks, not the parent row across the whole request.
p2.bound: Narrow in-flight window only; no steady-state/new-request bypass. Direct child-session revocation is still observed by the existing commit-time session check. This is the separately tracked #37 concern, not an issue47 regression.
p2.docs_declared: docs/browser-sessions.md states parent revocation is checked on request admission, that the parent token is not held/rechecked for the whole in-flight request, that a narrow in-progress write may finish after parent revocation, and that immediate interruption is a separate concern.

return_to.evidence: src/web/session.rs is_safe_return_to/percent_decode_ascii/header_safe_ascii: validates both raw path and percent-decoded whole/path, rejects malformed/double-encoded %, non-ASCII, controls, backslash, #, //, dot segments (. and ..), /web/login prefix, oversized/non-header-safe input; safe_return_to returns the original validated value or /web/repos.
return_to.observed: HTTP test asserts every bad target gets 303 Location /web/repos with no 500; login page probe maps encoded traversal to value=/web/repos.

credential_selection.evidence: src/web/session.rs WebAuthMode/web_auth_mode: explicit Authorization is authoritative; only a browser-kind credential matching the session cookie selects BrowserSession; a browser credential without a matching cookie is 401; API/other headers select HeaderApiOrOther so stale cookie validation cannot shadow them.
credential_selection.handler_no_fallback: src/web/handlers.rs normalize_web_headers returns the original headers unchanged whenever Authorization is present, so auth::authenticate never falls back to the cookie on malformed/invalid headers.
